title: Find Excel workbooks in OneDrive with AI by asking
h1: find the excel workbook before reading its cells
description: Use a bot to search OneDrive for Excel workbook files, narrow results by extension and return candidate file IDs without changing workbook contents.
keywords: excel search onedrive files with ai
answer: lost track of a spreadsheet? tell a bot part of its name or a phrase from the project and it searches your onedrive, including files people shared with you if you ask, and lists the excel files it finds. it only looks; nothing is opened or changed.
what:
start with the words you know, such as part of a workbook name or a project phrase. the query can match filenames, file details and file content. choose the drive to search when it is not the connected user's default, and specify workbook extensions if other file types would get in the way.

it can search everything you can see, including files shared with you, or only your own files. to read what's inside a workbook, the bot uses a separate excel action once you've picked the file.
uses: find the workbook for a past installation when you remember the project but not the filename
locate a shared costing workbook that does not live under your own drive hierarchy
collect candidate xlsx and xlsm files before selecting the one a report should read

routine.message: on the first of each month at 9, search my onedrive, including files shared with me, for excel files with "timesheet" in the name. go through every page of results and list the file names here, marking any you haven't shown me before.
routine.needs: excel connected with read only access for search drive files
routine.output:
timesheet workbooks
- timesheets-2026.xlsx
- timesheets-november-contractors.xlsm (new)
nothing opened or changed.

steps: connect excel in **Connected apps** and give the file finder **read only** access.
tell it the query phrase and whether the search should include files shared with you or only your drive hierarchy.
choose the file extensions you want and require all returned search pages to be considered before declaring no match.
pick the right workbook before asking the bot to read it. use **Edit** on the routine card to change the search words.
watch: this searches onedrive items through the excel connection. it is not a search of local folders or google drive.
the excel-only filter is applied one page of results at a time, so an empty page doesn't mean there are no workbooks. ask the bot to check every page.

faq.q: can it find an excel file someone shared with me?
faq.a: yes. ask it to include files shared with you. say "only my own files" if you want it narrower.

faq.q: does this search inside spreadsheet rows?
faq.a: the query may match file content, but the result is a list of drive items for workbook discovery. use a workbook range or table action after selecting a file to answer row-level questions.
